meta.title: Keep the passages that stayed with you
meta.description: ClippingKK turns your Kindle highlights into a quiet library of the passages you loved — easy to revisit, private by choice, and yours to share.

hero.title: Keep the passages that stayed with you.
hero.description: Bring in your Kindle highlights and ClippingKK sets them in order, book by book — a quiet library to return to, whenever a line comes back to you.
hero.note: Free to start. No card needed.

specimen.label: Highlighted on Kindle
specimen.highlight: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately,
specimen.rest: to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach.
specimen.author: Henry David Thoreau

clippings.title: From readers today
clippings.description: Passages readers chose to share, fresh from their libraries.

empty.title: No public highlights yet
empty.description: When readers share a passage, it will appear here.

books.title: On the shelves
books.description: Books readers are highlighting right now.

readers.title: Keeping a library here
readers.description: Only highlights a reader marks as public ever appear outside their library.

features.title: Everything you highlight, in one place

import.title: Import from Kindle
import.body: Add the My Clippings.txt file from your Kindle, and each highlight is matched to its book — cover, author and all.

library.title: A quiet library that is yours
library.body: Browse by book, return to a passage years later, and keep private whatever you would rather not share.

share.title: Share as posters, RSS or API
share.body: Turn a passage into a poster, follow a reader over RSS, or send your highlights on to other tools with webhooks and the API.

cta.title: Give your highlights a home.
cta.description: Start with the passages already waiting on your Kindle.
